item.title: Boston Scientific Corporation: Rapid Refill Continuous Injection System, UPN M00566001 Recall
item.product: Rapid Refill Continuous Injection System, UPN M00566001
item.summary: Devices contain recalled Medline Namic Angiographic Control Syringe with Rotating Adaptor. There is a risk of syringe loosening or disconnecting from the manifold, resulting in loose connection or complete disconnection. May lead to difficulty connecting syringe, inability to aspirate or inject properly, fluid leakage, or separation of the syringe from the system, potentially requiring device exchange and prolonging the procedure. Product details: Rapid Refill Continuous Injection System, UPN M00566001
